title: GDD T-112a — MECH_08 ¡SUJETA! cooperative hold-all-switches (§4) [split from TASK-041]
description:
Split slice 1 of TASK-041 (the ticket itself named 08/09/coop/Jefe as split candidates). Implement MECH_08 ¡SUJETA! on the canonical v2 IMicrogame contract (engine-free Core, injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick, difficultyScaling, MechanicParamSchema entry, TASK-030 validator entry, mutation-proven zero-alloc sensor) — mirror the shipped MECH_01/02/03/06/07 quality bar exactly.

Mechanic (GDD §4 MECH_08): 4 color switches; the TEAM wins by holding all required switches SIMULTANEOUSLY for holdWindow (default 1.5 s) within duration. Early release RESETS the hold window but NEVER fails the round (retryable until time runs out). Coop payout is IDENTICAL for all players — internal ranking within a coop mechanic is BANNED (GDD P2). infoAsym variant: only ONE rotating player sees the countdown; this information asymmetry must live in RenderState / BotView so views and bots respect it (the bot only knows what its seat can see). Read GDD §4 MECH_08 + §7 (coop framing) + P2 before coding.

Coop-abandonment rule (critical, AC1): an Idle/Empty seat automatically converts the requirement 4/4 -> 3/3 (and so on) so the coop objective can NEVER become impossible by a seat being abandoned. Verify at tick level.

Balance knobs (holdWindow, required-switch count, difficultyScaling mapping) are definition data passing the validator. Competitive/coop payout shape follows the existing coop payout system. Tests-first (tdd). Fast-suite testable (engine-free); no Unity gate. Coordinate the coop SPECIAL PHASE (§7.1) and Sequencer quota wiring in the sibling tickets / parent TASK-041.
acceptance_criteria: MECH_08 implements the v2 contract engine-free, seeded, zero-alloc steady Tick with a mutation-proven zero-alloc sensor; determinism lock (same seed => byte-identical)
The hold window validates ONLY when all required holds are overlapped at tick resolution; early release resets the window without failing the round (tick-timeline test)

An Idle/Empty seat converts the requirement 4/4 -> 3/3 automatically so the coop objective is never impossible by abandonment (tested); identical coop payout to all players verified (no internal ranking, GDD P2)
infoAsym variant: countdown visibility is per-seat in RenderState AND BotView so only the rotating seat can act on the timing (verified a non-viewing seat/bot cannot see it)
Balance knobs are definition data passing the TASK-030 validator; difficultyScaling mapping applied
Tests-first; full fast suite green after, no regression

comments.body:
CLOSED (loop iter 2, TASK-041 slice 1/4) — tdd, depth FULL. All 6 ACs met; fresh-context review rev-t076 APPROVE (no HIGH / no MEDIUM); orchestrator fast-suite gate independently 779/0.

DELIVERY: MECH_08 ¡SUJETA! coop hold-all-switches on the v2 contract (engine-free, injected SeededRandom [pure input fn, RNG never consumed], zero-alloc Tick). Commits: 4f71e38 (fast tests, genuine compile-red verified) / f6ee125 (feat: SujetaMicrogame/Params/Mode + SujetaBotPolicy + MicrogameId.Sujeta/EntityKind.Switch additive + schema) / d8e13bd (Editor-generated .meta sidecars). Fast 763->779 (+16, 0 regressions).

REVIEW (all non-vacuity verified firsthand): AC2 ALL-not-ANY (3-of-4 held forever => 0 windows) + early-release reset AND retry-to-real-completion; AC3 abandonment proven (idle seat's button NEVER pressed, a silent 4/4 would hang => pass proves the 4/4->3/3 conversion is real); AC4 infoAsym non-viewer meter=0 asserted AT a tick where the viewer's meter is provably >0 (structural withholding), with a real BotView wrap leg; zero-alloc sensor mutation-proven with windowsToWin=1000 exercising the complete+reset branch ~11x inside the measured window; P2 no-ranking structural (Ranks.Length==0) + ApplyCoop identical-to-all + never-zero (§6.1); anti-cheat clean (bot reads only BotView).

KEY DESIGN CALL — reviewer-blessed, NOT a defect: MECH_08 introduces a new `IsEngaged` predicate (Human-or-Bot only) that EXCLUDES HumanIdle from the coop requirement, distinct from PlayerRoster.IsActive (which counts HumanIdle as active for rendering). rev-t076 confirmed this is (a) explicitly mandated by AC3 + GDD §3.2 dead-seat spirit, (b) internally consistent (render still uses IsActive to draw the idle seat's switch, tagged VariantExcluded), (c) NO divergence with TASK-069 (SeatState.Bot correctly = engaged) or TASK-070 (idle board income orthogonal). Correct call, correctly scoped.

CARRY-FORWARD to TASK-078 (coop phase) / TASK-041 (sequencer wiring): rev-t076 LOW-3 — the infoAsym ViewerSeat rotation MUST rotate over ENGAGED seats only; if the sequencer ever hands ViewerSeat an Idle/Empty seat, the countdown is visible only to someone not required to act. The mechanic trusts the rotation caller. Wire ViewerSeat over engaged seats when integrating.

DEFERRED LOW nits: LOW-1 determinism test asserts Kind/CoopScore/Ranks not a byte-identical dump (acceptable: mechanic consumes zero RNG, determinism is structural); LOW-2 _engaged snapshot-at-Initialize vs live IsActive render read (fine under the roster-immutable-per-round contract; latent only if a future path mutates the roster mid-round).

[ASSUMED] for the ratification list (engineering defaults, GDD-silent): windowsToWin default=1 (logic general for N>1); switch layout fixed 2x2 grid @0.3/0.7; platformSync mode declared-not-implemented (falls back to HoldTogether, same treatment as EsquivaParams.JumpEnabled); difficultyScaling maps to hold-window LENGTH; ViewerSeat reuses SoloSeatRotation from TASK-040 (round-robin over active seats).
